scope: Classification checked against already-public citation titles and named record links. No new original-image reading, surname census total or identity upgrade is asserted. Changed citation titles require renewed review. Source-date reviews also distinguish verified biographical life dates from undated publications and inaccessible originals.

identified.basis: The citation's 1831 census entry is the NAI index record for Robt Glasgow, Coltrim house 2, Lissane, read 5 November 2026. The household head is Robert of Coltrim (Glasgow-3941), the 1820 Drapers' lessee and 1827 tithe occupier there. The citation stays on the Unknown Glasgow (Glasgow-3905) profile only as comparison evidence; no kinship to Adam of Inishrush is shown.

sources.basis: The Glass Family Bible, printed page 1 (PDF page 1): the typed extract states that its entries were attested by Ernest F. Gates, Notary Public, New London, Connecticut, on 20 May 1933. Use 1933 as the attested-extract date, not the Bible’s printing year or a family-event year. The page records events from William Glass’s stated birth in 1787 to Isabella’s death in 1885. Both archive URLs identify the same named ten-page scan. This is a typed derivative of the Bible, not an inspection of its original handwriting.
